text: G53's census rules, written before d3_p06_census.py runs; not an amendment. The census reads the six ruling files (P06-inst, -restrict, -addcond, -addstep, -link, -absent .jsonl), the spec files for their classes, and the six tag files. (1) A line shows P06 if it has a tag row: SHOW and P-G6 instantiate lines; S-SHOW restrict and add-condition lines; S-SHOW, S-OTHER with a tag row, E-PAIR and PART add-step and link lines; and absent REJ lines. A room shows P06 if any of its lines does. (2) For each room that shows P06, the census takes the union of its forms (TR, FF, OM, BO, DIS, Q). It marks the room Q-only where Q is its only form; TURN where any of its lines is tagged TURN; and AC-only where every line showing P06 in the room is tagged AC. (3) It counts the lines that do not show P06 by class: NOT, VIS, EL-NOT, EL-VIS, S-OTHER with no tag row, and absent evidence limits. It counts particulars apart, with PO among them. Rooms whose lines are all limits count apart again. (4) It gives the TURN share by form: the rooms with each form that also carry TURN. It also gives the TURN share among rooms whose forms are only blaming, wondering or disowning (BO, Q, DIS), the acts the cut said hold no coordinating turn. (5) It lists the paired elaborations and particulars that put attribution in an order, for the status ruling. The count does not decide the ruling.

P06's census by d3_p06_census.py, under the rules logged before it ran: 835 lines in 688 rooms. 691 lines show P06, in 563 rooms. Forms by room: TR 376, FF 210, OM 195, DIS 64, Q 32, BO 14; rooms by number of forms: 1 form 310, 2 forms 183, 3 forms 65, 4 forms 5. 6 rooms are Q-only, and 26 are AC-only (attribution only after hour 73). TURN: 246 of the 691 lines; 225 of the 563 rooms (0.400). TURN share by form: FF 100 of 210 (0.476), OM 88 of 195 (0.451), TR 156 of 376 (0.415), DIS 26 of 64 (0.406), Q 11 of 32 (0.344), BO 3 of 14 (0.214). Of the 24 rooms whose forms are only BO, Q or DIS, 4 carry TURN; of the 539 rooms with TR, FF or OM, 221 do (0.410). Lines not showing P06: absent evidence limits 101, VIS 21, EL-NOT 11, NOT 5, EL-VIS 4, S-OTHER 1, P-G6 1. Particulars: 18, of which 17 PO. Rooms not showing P06: 125, of which 105 hold only evidence limits. Ordering lines: 5 paired elaborations (10 add-step lines) and 2 particulars (rickandmorty-063 add-step, starlightstage-024 link). Decisions over the 835 lines: accept 769 (specification 643, elaboration 10, evidence limits 116), particular 18, reject 48. No correction.

P06's status ruling at D3a-48, made now that its group is read (D3a-01's note; QD3-002): P06 stays a candidate. No move is made, and the model's hash does not change. Why: (1) The return shows P06 widely. 691 of its 835 lines show it, in 563 of 688 rooms. Its acts are mostly tracing (376 rooms), finding friendly fire (210) or the room's own mistake (195). Rooms whose only forms are blaming officers, a question or disowning number 24. So the third clause of C5a-02's cost does not hold in the return: P06's acts are not mostly blaming and wondering. (2) A coordinating act answers the attribution in the same post or reply chain in 225 of the 563 rooms (0.400). For blaming, wondering and disowning alone it does so in 4 of 24 rooms. So the cut's claim that P06's acts hold no coordinating turn holds only for those forms. (3) The return still grounds no arrow for P06. TURN marks an answer within one post or chain, and the answers belong to several elements: repairs and defence (P05), calls (P01), talks and deals (P08), stopping and apology (P07), moves (P10), script fixes (P14). The commonest answer, members who stop repairing once told the change is the room's own, is P05's stated mechanism and not a P06 arrow. TURN is not an order between two elements' first acts across a room's record, which the other arrows were tested by. The add-step lines show four orders in two rooms each, and two orders in one room each. Under the admission rule C5a-02 applied (a process enters only with a grounded arrow), P06 is not re-admitted. It is not withdrawn either, since it is shown and the reason for the cut has narrowed to the missing arrow. Next comparison for P06: an order test by first acts across the room's record between P06 and P05 (attribution before the room stops or turns its repair), in the rooms that carry both, with its rules logged before it runs.
